tasks.title: Keep the field free of weeds
tasks.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing, before fertilizer.

benefit.text: Protects about 11 to 15% of your harvest

tasks.source: Critical weed-free period, field trials

tasks.title: Fertilizer, first dose
tasks.why: Put it the day before the water turn so the water carries it to the roots.

amount.label: About 75–85 kg of urea 46% per feddan (1.5 bags). For your 3 feddan: about 240 kg. Check the amount with your engineer.

benefit.text: Feeds the crop when it grows fastest

tasks.source: Timing from MALR wheat guide; amount from your engineer
